GitHub - Noah-Everett/Fast-Voxel-Traversal-Python: J. Amanatides, A ...
A blazing-fast, pure-Python implementation of the Amanatides-Woo voxel traversal algorithm, accelerated with Numba. Ideal for ray-marching, volume rendering, collision detection, and any application that needs to walk through a 3D voxel grid in O ( n x + n y + n z )
